question:
An LED emits at wavelength $\lambda=620\,\text{nm}$. Assume photon energy $E_{ph}\approx \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ with $hc=1240\,\text{eV\,nm}$.

The LED current is $I=20\,\text{mA}$. The external quantum efficiency is $\eta_{ext}=2\%$ (i.e., only $0.02$ photons are emitted per electron passing through).

Using $e=1.6\times 10^{-19}\,\text{C}$ and $1\,\text{eV}=1.6\times 10^{-19}\,\text{J}$, estimate (i) photon emission rate and (ii) optical power output.
